```{r}
library(tidyverse)

library(car)

```

```{r}
raw_data <- read.csv("KBS_Biomass_1990-2022_processed.csv")

summary(raw_data)
head(raw_data)

```

```{r}
new_data <- raw_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Treatment, Replicate, Station, Species, Fraction, Biomass) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Biomass)) %>% 
  group_by(Year, Treatment, Replicate, Station, Species) %>%
  summarise(Biomass = sum(Biomass)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Treatment, Replicate, Species) %>%
  summarise(Biomass = mean(Biomass)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Treatment, Replicate) %>%
  summarise(Biomass = sum(Biomass)) 

#write.csv(new_data, "KNZ_Biomass_1986-2021_processed.csv")
```
